| `content`    | `object`             |          | `\{\}`  | The widget configuration. - `field` (required) — the object field holding the array. - `key` — the item field that identifies an entry (default: the item itself for strings). - `row` — `{ title, titleFallback?, avatar?, meta?: [paths\|{ path, map?, format? }], pill?: { path, map?, variantMap? }, aside?: { path, format?, prefix?, fallback? }, detail?: { template, when?, copy?: [{ path, label }] } }`. `detail.copy` puts a copy button beside the detail line for each named value of the row (an empty value gets none), such as a DNS record's name and value. - `add` — `{ label?, fields: [{ key, label, type?: 'text'\|'select', options?, required?, pattern?, patternMessage? }], unique?, defaults? }`. - `remove` — `{ label? }`; omitted = no remove. - `rowActions` — `[{ id, label, when?, placement?: 'band', request: { method?, url, payload? } }]`; tokens `@object.&lt;field&gt;`, `@objectId`, `@row.&lt;field&gt;`. - `rowSource` — `{ url, path?, key }`: live per-row state merged by key. - `variant: 'table'` + `columns` — `[{ header, path, map?, format?, strong?, pill?, variantMap? }]`: rows as a table; a per-row "..." menu holds the row actions and remove; `detail` lines become a warning band under the table, with the row actions that have `placement: 'band'`. - `add.trigger: 'button'`, `add.placement: 'header' \| 'footer'` — the add form opens from a button. - `readOnly`, `hint`, `emptyText`. |
